_note: Guild quests (the board on the plaza). rank: the lowest rank that may take it. Objectives: kill <target> x count (credited when the player lands the killing blow), collect <item> x count (handed over at turn-in). Rewards: gold, XP (your guild rank comes from XP: data/ranks.json), items (into the backpack, or at your feet if it is full). Up to 'max_active' quests at once. rank: the lowest letter that may take it (any step of it). Repeatable quests rest for 'cooldown' seconds after you turn them in.

slime_cull.name: Slime Cull
slime_cull.desc: Slimes are eating every flower in the north meadow. Thin them out.

sticky_business.name: Sticky Business
sticky_business.desc: Bring me slime gel. Fresh, if you can manage it.

goblin_trouble.name: Goblin Trouble
goblin_trouble.desc: Goblins have set up camp west of town. Drive them off.

ear_bounty.name: Ear Bounty
ear_bounty.desc: The watch pays for proof. Goblin ears, five of them.
